title: English Practice Quiz 0926
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: When answering a business call, first ___.
options: identify the organisation or department and greet the caller
questions.explanation: identify the organisation or department and greet the caller is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: Before placing a caller on hold, you should ___.
questions.explanation: ask permission and explain briefly is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A caller requests confidential data you cannot disclose. You should ___.
options: explain the restriction and direct them to an authorised contact
questions.explanation: explain the restriction and direct them to an authorised contact is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: To transfer a call effectively, ___.
options: explain the transfer and identify the right department
questions.explanation: explain the transfer and identify the right department is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: If the phone line is unclear, ___.
options: politely ask the caller to repeat
questions.explanation: politely ask the caller to repeat is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A message for an absent colleague should include ___.
options: caller's name, contact details and purpose
questions.explanation: caller's name, contact details and purpose is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A professional telephone tone is ___.
questions.explanation: calm, clear and courteous is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: If you dial a wrong number, ___.
questions.explanation: apologise briefly and end politely is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: Before an outgoing business call, prepare ___.
questions.explanation: the purpose and relevant information is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: If a caller becomes abusive, ___.
options: remain professional and follow escalation procedure
questions.explanation: remain professional and follow escalation procedure is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.
